title: The Impossible Orchard
author: Odile Dravenmoor
blurb: Wren Vasquez, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
